title: The Two-Component Becker-Döring System: Basic Properties
summary: The two-component Becker-Döring model is a two-dimensional coagulation-fragmentation equation that describes the dynamics of clusters built from two different types of monomers growing and shrinking through monomer interaction. We show the existence and mass conservation of solutions and give a partial result regarding uniqueness. Furthermore, we prove under the assumption of detailed balance the entropy equation, followed by a detailed study of the equilibrium states and relative entropies.
